data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L8 ~ Polar Ray
data.name: Polar Ray
data.description: A blue-white ray of freezing air and ice springs from your hand. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the ray to deal damage to a target. The ray deals 1d6 points of cold damage per caster level [maximum 25d6] and 1d4 points of Dexterity drain.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
